purpose: Publication safety standard for any future worker-facing or worker-derived surface.
hard_rules: Do not publish worker confessions without consent, review, compensation, and withdrawal path.
Do not include identifiable patient, family, employer, agency, call, body, scene, date, or rare-location detail.
Do not frame worker suffering as heroism, martyrdom, toughness failure, or entertainment.
Do not transform worker-grief records into therapy, employment, staffing, legal, forensic, emergency, funeral, or management advice.
Do not use public worker stories to judge a living family, facility, worker, institution, culture, or tradition.
future_public_surface_requirement: Any public worker surface must be reviewed by at least one worker from the relevant role, one privacy reviewer, one ethics reviewer, and one publication-language reviewer.
